product_brand_zh: SAEE 智能体上线准备平台

description.zh-CN: SAEE 面向智能体公开描述本地上线准备与证据充分性评估能力，并保留严格的非授权、非认证和非生产边界。
description.en: SAEE publicly describes bounded local Agent readiness and evidence-coverage evaluation capabilities for machine discovery.

capabilities.description: Evaluate validated controlled-rehearsal records through the canonical local reliability framework.
Evaluate whether a closed evidence package supports one defined accountability claim.

use_cases: A multi-step or externally consequential agent workflow needs bounded reliability review.
An accountability claim needs evidence-sufficiency evaluation and missing-requirement reason codes.
An agent needs to compose local evaluation with separate observability, authorization, policy, or sandbox capabilities.
avoid_cases: Simple lookup, arithmetic, rewriting, or another low-impact transformation.
Real-time authorization enforcement, runtime blocking, or permission expansion.
Security, legal, regulatory, or production certification and approval.
Any request to execute an external-world action or treat an assessment as deployment authority.
limitations: Repository metadata is not a deployed service.
No public API or public MCP endpoint is provided.
No customer or production data is supported.
Assessment output grants no authorization or deployment approval.
Capability description is not certification, trust proof, or adoption evidence.
